Step: 17 weeks + 5 days = 17*7 + 5 = 119 + 5 = 124 days before 1225-08-25.  
1225 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
August 25 minus 124 days:  
Back to July: August 25 → July has 31 days, so 25 days back from Aug 25 = July 31.  
124 total days:  
From Aug 25 back 25 days → July 31 (25 days subtracted).  
Remaining days: 124 - 25 = 99 days before July 31.  
June has 30 days: 99 - 30 = 69 days left.  
May has 31 days: 69 - 31 = 38 days left.  
April has 30 days: 38 - 30 = 8 days left.  
March 31 minus 8 days = March 23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1225-03-23
